prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] defer_sign_in_after_adoption: Move account sign-in until after the pet adoption and customization flow is completed so users personalize their pet before registering. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion and 89s median duration while sign_in drops 27.1% of users with high mean time (567s). Allowing users to adopt first builds emotional investment.)
1: [home, new_flow] interactive_wait_minigame: Transform the pet preparation waiting screen into an interactive preview stage with animated pet interactions and time estimates. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s) and 18.7% user dropoff while pet assets load.)
2: [sign_in, hint] account_pet_persistence_warning: Display explicit account reassurance messaging clarifying that signing in saves and syncs your pet permanently to prevent pet loss. (why: Support received 8 emails (the largest single feedback group) about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] desktop_launch_troubleshooter_tip: Add desktop rendering tips and system tray indicators on the waiting screen so users know where to look when setup completes. (why: Support received 3 reports of pets failing to display on desktop or app refusing to open after setup.)
4: [adoption, copy] custom_photo_guidelines: Add explicit photo quality recommendations and clear formatting hints on the pet photo upload step. (why: Support received 3 bug reports regarding custom pet generation failing or looking distorted after photo upload.)
5: [finish, notification] desktop_pet_summon_shortcut_banner: Highlight pet summon shortcut key (Alt+P) and desktop tray notification controls on the home introduction screen. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% (mean time 5815s) and support receives multiple confusion emails post-onboarding.)

Strongest evidence with 8 support emails and 27.1% dropoff; copy change is zero-effort.
